description_en: Update a batch operations card job
kebab_example: aliyun cc5g update-batch-operate-cards-task --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --batch-operate-cards-task-id boct-xxxx --region cn-hangzhou
name: UpdateBatchOperateCardsTask

parameters.help_en:
Ensures idempotence of the request. Generate a unique value from your client for this parameter to guarantee uniqueness across different requests. Only ASCII characters are supported, and the value cannot exceed 64 characters.
If you do not specify this parameter, the system automatically uses the RequestId of the API request as the ClientToken. The RequestId may differ for each API request
parameters.help_zh:
保证请求幂等性。从您的客户端生成一个参数值，确保不同请求间该参数值唯一。只支持ASCII字符，且不能超过64个字符。
若您未指定，则系统自动使用API请求的RequestId作为ClientToken标识。每次API请求的RequestId可能不一样
parameters.name: client_token

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to perform only a dry run of the request. Valid values:
true: Sends a dry run request without updating the batch operations card job. The system checks whether required parameters are provided, whether the request format is valid, and whether business limits are met. If the check fails, an error is returned. If the check passes, the error code `DryRunOperation` is returned.
false (default): Sends a normal request. After passing the checks, the batch operations card job is updated
parameters.help_zh:
是否只预检此次请求。取值：
true：发送检查请求，不会更新批量操作卡任务。检查项包括是否填写了必需参数、请求格式、业务限制。如果检查不通过，则返回对应错误。如果检查通过，则返回错误码`DryRunOperation`。
false（默认值）：发送正常请求，通过检查后更新批量操作卡任务
parameters.name: dry_run

parameters.help_en: A list of IDs of 5G high-speed cloud instances. A maximum of 10 IDs can be specified
parameters.help_zh: 5G高速上云实例的id列表，最多10个
parameters.name: wireless_cloud_connector_ids

parameters.help_en: A list of ICCIDs of cards. A maximum of 200 ICCIDs can be specified
parameters.name: iccids

parameters.help_en: The OSS file path where the ICCID file is stored
parameters.name: iccids_oss_file_path

parameters.help_en:
The throttling type. Valid values: 

BreakNetwork: Disconnect the network when the threshold is exceeded.
LimitRate: Apply throttling when the threshold is exceeded.
Alarm: Trigger an alert when the threshold is exceeded
parameters.help_zh:
限制类型，取值: 

BreakNetwork: 达量断网
LimitRate: 达量限速
Alarm: 达量告警
parameters.name: operate_type

parameters.help_en:
The effect type. Valid values:
CurrentMonth
ContinualMonth
parameters.help_zh:
生效类型，取值：

CurrentMonth
ContinualMonth
parameters.name: effect_type

parameters.help_en: The ID of the Batch Operations job
parameters.name: batch_operate_cards_task_id
